grain: one NYC local calendar date + hour + authoritative TLC Taxi Zone polygon

zone_domain.taxi_location_id_265: Outside of NYC - excluded from spatial Gold

aggregation_rules.taxi_trips: COUNT(*) of Taxi Silver rows by pickup date/hour/PULocationID
aggregation_rules.complaints_311: COUNT(*) of spatially mapped 311 complaints by created date/hour/taxi_zone_location_id
aggregation_rules.temperature_c: hourly Weather Silver observation repeated across all authoritative Taxi Zones
aggregation_rules.rain_mm: hourly Weather Silver observation repeated across all authoritative Taxi Zones
aggregation_rules.snowfall_cm: hourly Weather Silver observation repeated across all authoritative Taxi Zones
aggregation_rules.weather_condition: hourly Weather Silver WMO-derived condition repeated across all authoritative Taxi Zones

revenue_definition: Taxi revenue is SUM(total_amount) for Taxi Silver trips whose pickup LocationID is an authoritative polygon ID 1-263.

taxi_reconciliation.temporal_assignment_rule: Gold month is determined by pickup_date, not physical Taxi Silver partition.
